plugins.description: HarnessFlow v5.0.0：主链 hf-workflow → hf-grill-with-docs → hf-to-product-architecture → hf-to-spec → hf-to-architecture → hf-to-tickets → hf-implement → hf-ship，配有跨阶段的 hf-review（含代码双轴门）。技能正文改编自 mattpocock/skills（MIT）。有 UI 时加载 hf-ui-design。通过 stdlib install.py（copy/symlink）安装到 Cursor/OpenCode，并由轻量的 install.sh/install.ps1 包装脚本提供入口。
